name: vibespec

scripts.check: node tools/spec.ts check && npm run check --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: node -e "fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "fs.mkdirSync('dist/proof', { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync('tools/proof/lib.dfy', 'dist/proof/lib.dfy'); fs.copyFileSync('tools/conformance.ts', 'dist/conformance.ts'); fs.cpSync('tools/studio/public', 'dist/studio/public', { recursive: true })"
scripts.prepare: npm run build && node tools/spec.ts gen --if-valid

description: Stories, rules and Quint models in linked Markdown specs; verified TypeScript out.
